name: NASCAR Scores
description: Returns voice-friendly Cup, O’Reilly Auto Parts, or Truck race results from NASCAR’s credential-free public CDN feeds.

nodes.name: NASCAR Tool Webhook
nodes.notes: NASCAR scores tool. Optional JSON input: series (cup, xfinity, truck), season, top (1-10), race_id.

parameters.content:
## Credential-free NASCAR results

Uses NASCAR’s public CDN cache:
- Season: `cf.nascar.com/cacher/{year}/.../race_list_basic.json`
- Result: `cf.nascar.com/cacher/{year}/{series}/{race}/weekend-feed.json`

No account, API key, or credential is required. The workflow selects the latest completed race before requesting its detailed results.

Input: `series` = cup/xfinity/truck; optional `season`, `top` (1-10), or `race_id`.
